page.overview:
Who is A.G. Bell?

Following the enactment of the Superhuman Registration Act, and during the subsequent superhuman civil war, Phone Ranger was arrested by Iron Man, Spider-Man, and the NYPD, alongside Lectronn, Lightbright, and Wildstreak. After Captain America surrendered, Bell accepted the offered super hero amnesty for former members of the rebellion.
